statement: The primary-emit seam applies the shared incremental _mesh_safe guard to every short-record loop (the one emission that had none). A refused loop is dropped only when its area is <= PRIMARY_LOOP_AREA_REL (1%) of the store-level assembled mesh area; a larger over-use is kept exactly as before. The two outcomes are counted (primary_loop_skips / primary_loop_kept) and named (primary-loop-manifold-skip / primary-loop-manifold-kept).
label: fact

statement: The seam is a two-pass entry: a registry pass with the seam off measures the store mesh's area (store-level, so a per-rep store's duplicate loop is compared against the whole part, not one rep), then the guarded pass runs with that reference. Deterministic; the cost is one extra triangulation of already-parsed records.
label: fact

statement: The fire gate (the stage-15 dedup law's discipline): the seam stands only where it RESOLVES the store's over-use. If the guarded mesh is still not manifold (a larger over-use is kept), the pre-seam decode is returned unchanged and the candidates are named (primary_loop_seam_declined / primary-loop-manifold-declined).
